Name: Survivalistic - Hunger and Thirst (Rebooted)
Author: Locked15
Description:
[b][size=6]DESCRIPTION:[/size][/b]
[size=3]Adds some survival odds to the game, with different penalty and feed/hydrate values to each tool/food![/size]
[size=3]If you want to get information about versions and / or config options, you can open corresponding articles available on this
mod page.[/size][size=4]

If you want to make early game more playable (beginning may be a bit tough because you're short of money), you can use some mods with cheap meal ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25681]like this one[/url]).
[/size]

[size=6][b]MOD FEATURES:[/b][/size]
[size=3]Some of the features, including:[/size]
[list]
[*]Hunger and Thirst bar.
[*]Different penalties depending on the tool you're using.
[*]Different feed and hydrate values to edible items.
[/list]

[size=6][b]ACTUAL COMPATIBLE MODS:[/b][/size]
All compatibility patches are included to the base release.

[size=4][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/size]
With the release 1.1.0 custom patches structure was revamped.
Please, look to the existing patches and / or "Guide" file in the mod folder for more information.
Patches created before this patch were updated and available in the original release.


[size=6][b]ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][b][size=4]SOURCE CODE:[/size][/b]
[left]Original mod source code: [url=https://github.com/Ophaneom/Survivalistic]https://github.com/Ophaneom/Survivalistic[/url];
Rebooted version source code: [url=https://github.com/Locked15/SDV_Survivalistic-Rebooted]https://github.com/Locked15/SDV_Survivalistic-Rebooted[/url]﻿.[/left]
[b][size=4]CREDITS:
[/size][/b]Original mod was created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/109604218]Ophaneom[/url] (available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12179]here[/url]).
Rebooted update was created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44835082]Locked15[/url].

Code refactoring (especially interaction-relevant).
Fixes for some bugs (including Screenshot mode support) and incorrect stats drain.

Also includes translation changes, please go to the GitHub releases to see more.
